question: A, B and C are three numbers. A is 40% less than B and B is 15% less than C. If C is 50% more than D, then A will be less than D by:
solution:
Given:

A, B, and C are three numbers. 

A is 40% less than B and B is 15% less than C.

C is 50% more than D,

Calculation:

Let D be 100.

C = 100 + 100 × 50%

⇒ 100 + 50 = 150

B = 150 - 150 × 15%

⇒ 150 - 150 × 15/100

⇒ 150 - 22.5 = 127.5

A = 127.5 - 127.5 × 40%

⇒ 127.5 - 51 = 76.5

Now, A will be less than D by = {{100 - 76.5} over 100} × 100

⇒ 23.5%

∴ A will be less than D by 23.5%.
